info.title: Xero Assets API
info.description: The Assets API exposes fixed asset related functions of the Xero Accounting application and can be used for a variety of purposes such as creating assets, retrieving asset valuations etc.

get.description: By passing in the appropriate options, you can search for available fixed asset in the system

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Required when retrieving a collection of assets. See Asset Status Codes

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results are paged. This specifies which page of the results to return. The default page is 1

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of records returned per page. By default the number of records returned is 10

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Requests can be ordered by AssetType, AssetName, AssetNumber, PurchaseDate and PurchasePrice. If the asset status is DISPOSED it also allows DisposalDate and DisposalPrice

parameters.name: filterBy
parameters.description: A string that can be used to filter the list to only return assets containing the text. Checks it against the AssetName, AssetNumber, Description and AssetTypeName fields

post.description: Adds an asset to the system

200.description: return single object - create new asset

get.description: By passing in the appropriate options, you can search for available fixed asset types in the system

depreciationMethod.description: The method of depreciation applied to this asset. See Depreciation Methods

averagingMethod.description: The method of averaging applied to this asset. See Averaging Methods

effectiveLifeYears.description: Effective life of the asset in years (e.g. 5)

depreciableObjectId.description: Unique Xero identifier for the depreciable object

bookEffectiveDateOfChangeId.description: Unique Xero identifier for the effective date change

resourceName.description: The field name of the erroneous field

detail.description: Detail of the resource validation error

type.description: Internal type of the resource error message

title.description: Title of the resource validation error

localisedMessage.description: Explanation of the resource validation error

assetTypeId.description: Xero generated unique identifier for asset types

assetTypeName.description: The name of the asset type

depreciationExpenseAccountId.description: The expense account for the depreciation of fixed assets of this type

fixedAssetAccountId.description: The asset account for fixed assets of this type

accumulatedDepreciationAccountId.description: The account for accumulated depreciation of fixed assets of this type

locks.description: All asset types that have accumulated depreciation for any assets that use them are deemed ‘locked’ and cannot be removed

currentCapitalGain.description: When an asset is disposed, this will be the sell price minus the purchase price if a profit was made.

currentGainLoss.description: When an asset is disposed, this will be the lowest one of sell price or purchase price, minus the current book value.

costLimit.description: The value of the asset you want to depreciate, if this is less than the cost of the asset.

residualValue.description: The value of the asset remaining when you've fully depreciated it.

priorAccumDepreciationAmount.description: All depreciation prior to the current financial year.

currentAccumDepreciationAmount.description: All depreciation occurring in the current financial year.

businessUseCapitalGain.description: (New Zealand Orgs Only) The portion of capital gain realised from the disposal of a fixed asset that is attributable to its business use.

businessUseCurrentGainLoss.description: (New Zealand Orgs Only) Represents the gain or loss from the disposal of the business use portion of a fixed asset. This value records the financial result (profit or loss) related specifically to the asset’s business use.

privateUseCapitalGain.description: (New Zealand Orgs Only) The portion of capital gain realised from the disposal of a fixed asset that is attributable to its private (non-business) use.

privateUseCurrentGainLoss.description: (New Zealand Orgs Only) Represents the gain or loss from the disposal of the private use portion of a fixed asset. This value records the financial result (profit or loss) related specifically to the asset’s private use.

initialDeductionPercentage.description: (New Zealand Orgs Only) The Investment Boost deduction percentage.

assetNumberPrefix.description: The prefix used for fixed asset numbers (“FA-” by default)

assetStartDate.description: The date depreciation calculations started on registered fixed assets in Xero

defaultGainOnDisposalAccountId.description: Default account that gains are posted to

defaultCapitalGainOnDisposalAccountId.description: Default account that capital gains are posted to

defaultLossOnDisposalAccountId.description: Default account that losses are posted to

fieldName.description: The field name of the erroneous field

detail.description: Detail of the field validation error

type.description: Internal type of the field validation error message

title.description: Title of the field validation error

localisedMessage.description: Explanation of the field validation error

purchaseDate.description: The date the asset was purchased YYYY-MM-DD

assetTypeId.description: The Xero-generated Id for the asset type

purchasePrice.description: The purchase price of the asset

isDeleteEnabledForDate.description: Boolean to indicate whether delete is enabled

warrantyExpiryDate.description: The date the asset’s warranty expires (if needed) YYYY-MM-DD

assetId.description: The Xero-generated Id for the asset

accountingBookValue.description: The accounting value of the asset

disposalDate.description: The date the asset was disposed

canRollback.description: Boolean to indicate whether depreciation can be rolled back for this asset individually. This is true if it doesn't have 'legacy' journal entries and if there is no lock period that would prevent this asset from rolling back

disposalPrice.description: The price the asset was disposed at

idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKey.description: This allows you to safely retry requests without the risk of duplicate processing. 128 character max
